_comment: Every CSS rule that ui_status_color_check.mjs's colour-only scan flags (a status-ish selector whose declaration block is only color/background/border-color pointing at --ok/--warn/--bad/--neutral) has to be listed here with a one-line note on why it's already safe -- usually because a sibling text/glyph at the call site carries the same information. The scan can't see the JS/HTML side, only the CSS shape, so it can't verify these notes itself; a human added them during the 2026-09 colour-dependence audit by reading each call site. A NEW rule of this shape is NOT in this file and fails the build until reviewed the same way.

diagnostics_page.html.note: always renders next to its own text, e.g. 'FAULT pin: yes' -- the word carries the state, colour is reinforcement.

main_page.html.note: the element's text content is the error message itself; the class only recolours it.

profiles_page.html.note: wraps a full warning sentence set by JS; colour only recolours existing text.
2026-09 audit fix: checkRamp() now also sets input.title on this state (see profiles_page.html), a non-colour cue this CSS-only scan can't see.

readiness_page.html.note: readiness_page.html's MARK[] map gives every status (ok/not_done/deliberately_off/cannot_yet) its own glyph (✓/✗/—/⋯); colour only reinforces an already-distinct glyph.

safety_commissioning_page.html.note: co-occurs with a '⚠ not set' badge (.field.unset::before-style label in the same rule block) and border-width 2px -- not colour alone.

safety_page.html.note: the value text itself differs per state (e.g. 'linked'/'OK' vs 'not linked'/'INCOMPATIBLE'); colour only reinforces text that already differs.
2026-09 audit fix: render() now appends ' -- WARN'/' -- NEAR LIMIT' etc. to the value text for this class (see safety_page.html), a non-colour cue this CSS-only scan can't see.
always paired with the bold '!! TRIP_INEFFECTIVE !!' row text and a separate breaker-warning banner -- not colour alone.

zones_page.html.note: PROPOSAL, not yet fixed (see WEB_UI_RESPONSIVE_PLAN.md): the RGA matrix's diagonal cell is genuinely colour-only today -- only the plain number, no glyph. Left as a documented proposal because a fix here (appending a character to a table cell) risks widening the matrix's fixed-width columns, which is a repaint this pass is not authorized to make. The verdict paragraph directly below the table (verdict-ok/warn/bad, also in this file) already carries the full explanation in text for the worst cell, which is the load-bearing read.
full explanatory sentence, e.g. 'Every diagonal element is within...'; colour only reinforces text.
full explanatory sentence; colour only reinforces text.
full explanatory sentence; colour only reinforces text.
